observations: White sewing machine with a digital control panel.
The brand name 'JINJI' is visible on the top of the machine in photo 0.
The machine is shown with its power cord and a black foot pedal.
The background features a tiled wall with a repeating pattern of text.
A watermark 'POSTED BY ISAAC JIJI' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The machine is shown powered on in photo 0, but internal mechanical health cannot be confirmed from a still image.
The stitch selection buttons on the digital panel are not clearly visible to confirm the number of stitch types.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or the motor may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and the needle moving through the fabric.

risks.risk: The digital display may be damaged or unresponsive.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the display while the machine is powered on.

risks.risk: The stitch selection buttons may be faulty or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the stitch selection buttons and the stitch pattern selector.
risks.if_unproven: as having a limited or broken stitch selection

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and sewing through fabric.
Photo of the stitch selection buttons and the stitch pattern selector.
Photo of the machine with the power cord and foot pedal fully assembled.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
